description: This file defines the LocalDispatcher interface, which serves as the main API for the service engine within the Apache Ofbiz framework. It declares methods for running services synchronously and asynchronously, managing service schedules, callbacks, and transaction-related services, as well as retrieving associated components like JobManager, Delegator, and Security.

classes.name: LocalDispatcher
classes.description: Interface representing a local service dispatcher responsible for managing service execution, scheduling, callbacks, and related operations within the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: initDispatchContext
methods.description: Initializes the dispatch context for this dispatcher after creation.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Temporarily disables execution of Service Engine Condition Actions.

methods.name: enableEcas
methods.description: Re-enables execution of Service Engine Condition Actions.

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks if Service Engine Condition Actions are disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result. Overloaded to accept different parameters for timeout and context.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously, passing a requester to handle the result. Multiple overloads support different parameters.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter object for result retrieval.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback listener for a specific service.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specific time, with various overloads supporting recurring schedules and context.

methods.name: addRollbackService
methods.description: Registers a service to run as a rollback during transaction operations.

methods.name: addCommitService
methods.description: Registers a service to run as a commit during transaction operations.

methods.name: getJobManager
methods.description: Retrieves the JobManager associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getJMSListeneFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the JMS Listener Factory for message listeners.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Retrieves the Delegator associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Retrieves the Security object associated with this dispatcher.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this dispatcher.

methods.name: getDispatchContext
methods.description: Retrieves the DispatchContext created by this dispatcher.
